selected_evidence.requirement: inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group created
selected_evidence.summary: groupadd/useradd created inventory-readers (gid 1000) and inventorysvc (uid 996); confirmed via id and getent group

selected_evidence.requirement: Ownership set to inventorysvc:inventory-readers with restrictive permissions
selected_evidence.summary: chown -R and chmod 750/640 applied; ls -laR shows inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership and drwxr-x---/-rw-r----- perms on all files and directories

selected_evidence.requirement: Existing data content preserved through the repair
selected_evidence.summary: sha256sum of config.json and records.csv identical before and after the chown/chmod operations

selected_evidence.requirement: Data readable by inventory-readers group and inaccessible to other users
selected_evidence.summary: sudo -u tests: inventorysvc (owner) and reader_test (group member) could read config.json; other_test (unrelated) got Permission denied on both file read and directory listing. Temporary test users then removed
Final ls -laR confirms inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership, 750 dirs / 640 files across /srv/inventory

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
